title: Clocked comparator, continuous-time physical macromodel
description: Continuous-time sibling of comparator_clocked with its OWN contract: a transparent track-and-hold macromodel (tanh diff-pair decision, master/slave sampling gated by a smooth clock, ramp delay generator, slew-limited edge, thevenin rout). It samples on the rising clock crossing of vth_clk with a FINITE acquisition aperture, exhibits overdrive-dependent decision time near the dif_band boundary (physical behavior), and holds the retained decision by weak regeneration. Choose comparator_clocked for ideal event semantics; choose this block for a transparent, OSDI-compilable, exportable continuous model.

output_drive.edge_convention: t_rise/t_fall between vlo and vhi levels; td is measured clock-threshold to out 50% crossing

parameters.name: td
parameters.description: Clock-threshold-crossing to output-50%-crossing latency. Must exceed tedge/2 + 7 ps: 7 ps is the largest fixed event-chain overhead across the executable backends (native needs 2 ps, xspice-cosim 7 ps), so every admitted parameterization yields the declared td on both.

parameters.name: tedge
parameters.description: Output rise/fall time between vlo and vhi.

parameters.name: vhyst
parameters.description: Full hysteresis width applied as +/-vhyst/2 threshold shift from the retained decision. Exactly zero disables hysteresis.

parameters.name: clk_band
parameters.description: Declared clock ambiguity band; event ordering inside it is unspecified.

parameters.name: dif_band
parameters.description: Declared decision ambiguity band around zero differential input.

state.name: decision
state.value_before_first_event: held low (~0.0007 of full scale) until the first rising clock crossing; OP/DC resolve this default even with the clock parked high (leak-only master has a unique operating point)

unsupported.behavior: No meaningful small-signal path through the sampled decision; AC describes only the passive output stage.
Noise contributions are absent, not zero-modeled; report noise as unavailable.

regularization.name: decision latency calibration
regularization.scaling_rule: ramp half-time compensated for acquisition (tau_trk) and the tedge/2 slew delay; internal time constants scale with td and headroom
regularization.tested_error_bound: worst 2.64% of td at the td~tedge/2 boundary, <=1% elsewhere (battery), at tstep <= td/10; coarser tstep adds ~tstep/2

regularization.name: decision aperture and boundary softness
regularization.magnitude: clock aperture ~clk_band; decision boundary +dif_band/2, tanh width dif_band/8
regularization.scaling_rule: both sit inside the contract's declared ambiguity bands
regularization.tested_error_bound: zero differential resolves low; overdrive >= 2*dif_band restores the declared latency (battery)

regularization.name: edge realization
regularization.magnitude: slew-limited output: linear ramp spanning tedge, 10-90 = 0.8*tedge within 15%
regularization.tested_error_bound: measured rising and falling on the tedge grid (battery)

limitations: Track-and-hold, not an ideal edge sampler: acquisition needs the clk-high (and clk-low) phase to exceed ~td for the declared latency; phases under ~0.09*td never decide (deterministic low) and intermediate phases decide late.

Decision time is overdrive-dependent near the dif_band boundary: differentials within ~2*dif_band above the boundary decide arbitrarily slowly (physical metastability analogue); the latency bound applies for overdrive >= 2*dif_band.
The retained decision holds indefinitely while the clock is LOW (weak regeneration); a clock PARKED high couples the slave to the leak-only master and the held output sags after ~250 us * (td/2 ns).
The clock must start at a rail (or below vth_clk - clk_band/2) at t=0; starting inside the clk_band aperture can resolve the current input decision at OP.
No metastability model beyond the deterministic-low dif_band interior; no kickback, input offset parameter, or supply-current model.
td must exceed tedge/2 + 7 ps (shared relational constraint); below it the delay-generator headroom is floored and td is not honored.

timing.ambiguity_window: clk_band around vth_clk; dif_band around zero differential; both declared parameters.
timing.latency_definition: td = time from clock crossing vth_clk (rising) to out crossing (vhi+vlo)/2, within the declared 3%+10ps regularization bound for overdrive >= 2*dif_band and clock phases >= td.

verilog-a.notes: The only backend: continuous Verilog-A compiled through the reviewed OSDI path (compiles on classic openvaf 23.5.0 and openvaf-r). The event-construct screen (osdi.source.event_constructs) passes this source by construction. Battery: tests/test_blocks_osdi_comparator.py.
